Jordan Rivera
Senior Backend Engineer
jordan.rivera@example.com | +44 7700 900456 | London, UK | linkedin.com/in/jordan-rivera-example

Summary
Backend engineer with 8 years building payment and ledger systems in Go, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

• Reduced p95 API latency from 800ms to 150ms by adding Redis caching and tuning 40 slow queries.
• Mentored 6 engineers through promotion cycles and set up the team's design review process.
Backend Engineer — Fabrikam Retail | Jan 2018 – Feb 2021
• Built the order service in TypeScript serving 900k monthly customers across 4 markets.
• Migrated 35 cron jobs to Kubernetes, saving $6k per month in infrastructure spend.
• Automated releases with GitHub Actions, shrinking deploy time from 40 to 7 minutes.
Software Engineer — Contoso Labs | Jul 2016 – Dec 2017
• Developed 10 REST APIs in Node.js for a logistics client, handling 250 requests per second at peak.
• Raised integration test coverage from 35% to 80% across the core services in six months.
• Shipped an operations dashboard adopted by 25 staff within its first month of release.

Education
BSc Computer Science — University of Westbridge | 2012 – 2016

Skills
Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
